user_problem: Operators have runbooks but cannot quickly see which procedure applies to a reported situation.
unique_output: A scenario-to-procedure table with observable signals, applicable runbook section, exclusions, and escalation trigger.
test_case: Map six incident descriptions to three supplied procedures and leave an unmatched scenario for escalation.
overlap_to_check: Support replies, retry audits, and security incident systems.
specific_guardrail: Map supplied observations to supplied procedures using explicit applicability rules; unmatched/conflicting scenarios remain escalation gaps. Do not execute runbooks or invent remediation.
